runner: manual measurement (agent-driven, not a research/runners/*.py CLI)
script: ad-hoc scripts run via .venv/bin/python against research.runners._keystone2_spiking_slot_binder_derisk.build_binder_bridge and research.runners.rf_phasor_composer.RFPhasorComposer; scripts themselves not checked in (scratchpad); this JSON is the durable record
cmd: SIM_BACKEND=numpy .venv/bin/python <script> --one K KF   (per data point; subprocess per point so ru_maxrss reflects that point only)
backend: numpy (CPU) -- explicit SIM_BACKEND=numpy, not the default fallback: GPU was busy running a queued cupy fluency sweep at measurement time (tools/gpu_queue.sh status: 96% util, 19585/24576 MiB used, 4513 MiB free), per this task's own instruction to measure on CPU and extrapolate VRAM analytically when the GPU is busy. float32/int32/bool array byte sizes are backend-independent, so the bytes-per-synapse ratio transfers directly to a cupy/GPU run of the identical code path.
purpose: L1 de-risk from research/findings/2026-09-04-vsa-composer-learned-retirement-ROADMAP.md: measure SlotBinderComposer's dense O(K*KF) slot->filler pathway at the live production scale (404 facts / 788-word full vocab, read from bridges/developed/scale787/day_33/brain.json + facts.json) against the single-consumer-RTX-3090 (24GB) reference.

production_scale_derivation.source: bridges/developed/scale787/day_33/brain.json (n_facts=404, vocab len=788, D=128, composer_kind='rf') + facts.json (404 facts, each with exactly 4 populated roles: agent/action/patient/polarity)
production_scale_derivation.K_formula: 5 roles (agent,action,patient,polarity,attribute) * max_facts(404) = 2020, per SlotBinderComposer._ROLES=5 and K=_ROLES*self.max_facts (research/runners/slotbinder_composer.py L42,L84)
production_scale_derivation.KF_formula: vocab(788) + 3 internal fillers (AFFIRM,NEGATE,NOATTR) + max_clauses(=max_facts=404 by default) clause-pointer labels = 1195, per SlotBinderComposer.__init__ self._vocab construction (L66) -- this refines the 2026-08-25 finding's loose 'KF~=300-800' guess, which did not account for the +3 and +404 clause-pointer filler pools the constructor always appends

edge_count_formula.text: nnz = K*KF*400 (dense plastic slot->filler, density=1.0, n_word*n_fill=20*20=400 edges per pool-pair) + K*400 (NMDA self-recurrent) + K*480 (slot->fs) + K*480 (fs->slot) = K*KF*400 + K*1360

empirical_build_measurements_cpu_numpy.note: GPU busy at measurement time (tools/gpu_queue.sh: SIM_BACKEND=cupy fluency sweep running, 96% util, 19585/24576 MiB used) -- measured on CPU/numpy per task instruction, extrapolated analytically for VRAM. dtype sizes (float32/int32/bool) are backend-independent so bytes/synapse transfers directly to a cupy/GPU run.

per_step_wall_time_cpu_numpy.note: timed b._run_one_simulation_step() directly (30 steps, 1 warmup), CPU/numpy, same reason as above

gpu_resident_bytes_per_synapse_exact_int.method: exhaustive scan of every bridge.cp_* array whose length == nnz or == round(1.5*nnz), at K=160/KF=160 (nnz=10457600)

production_scale_extrapolation.gpu_resident_steady_state_gb_project_gat: using tools/gates/consumer_hardware_reference.py's own worst-case-all-features-on itemization (200 bytes/neuron, 64 bytes/synapse, 8x co-residency safety multiplier, +1GiB fixed overhead) as a cross-check against the project's own standard estimator; both this figure and the direct 36.07 GB measured-ratio figure exceed the 24GiB single-consumer-RTX-3090 reference
production_scale_extrapolation.worst_case_single_query_seconds_extrapol: up to ~131000s (404 facts x 2 cue-slots x 40 retr_steps x 4.06s/step) for the _match() linear scan's worst case (query for the LAST-stored or an unstored fact)

fhrr_rf_composer_comparison_same_real_sc.query_correctness_3_of_3_probes: boy/go->park (exp park); king/rule->part (exp part); tower/fall->crash (exp crash) -- all correct
fhrr_rf_composer_comparison_same_real_sc.why_so_cheap: the RF/FHRR bridge is a FIXED ~D-scale (128, or D+V<=~916 for the optional spiking-cleanup bank) neuron population, reused (bridge-cached by neuron count) and time-multiplexed across every bind/unbind/read op for every fact and every word -- it does NOT allocate a dedicated neuron population or a dense synaptic pathway per (fact,role,filler) combination. connections_per_neuron=0 in _build_rf_bridge; the real per-fact state is a host numpy list (self.kb, ~2KB/fact) not on-substrate synapses.

preconditions.name: edge_count_formula_matches_measured_nnz_exactly
preconditions.detail: K*KF*400+K*1360 matched the ACTUAL built bridge's nnz exactly at all 4 tested (K,KF) points (53600, 694400, 10457600, 26562560) -- the extrapolation basis is exact, not approximate.

preconditions.name: gpu_resident_bytes_per_synapse_from_exhaustive_introspection_not_hand_picked_list
preconditions.detail: a first pass hand-picking 5 array names under-counted by 40% (17 vs the true 32 bytes/synapse excl. CSR); corrected by scanning every bridge.cp_* attribute whose length matches nnz or 1.5x nnz.

preconditions.name: byte_sizes_backend_independent_so_cpu_measurement_transfers_to_gpu
preconditions.detail: float32/int32/bool dtype sizes do not change between numpy and cupy; the same build_binder_bridge code path allocates the same arrays regardless of SIM_BACKEND, so a CPU-measured bytes/synapse ratio is valid for a GPU/cupy run of the identical code.

preconditions.name: fhrr_comparison_measured_directly_at_identical_real_scale_not_extrapolated
preconditions.detail: RFPhasorComposer was actually built and exercised at D=128/vocab=788/facts=404 (research/findings/raw/_fhrr_rf_composer_live_scale_404facts.json), not extrapolated -- an apples-to-apples same-scale comparison, not a scaled guess.

preconditions.name: extrapolation_distance_is_modest_relative_to_the_fitted_range
preconditions.detail: the fit spans nnz 53600->26562560 (~496x); extrapolating to nnz_full=968307200 is a further ~36x beyond the largest measured point, well inside the ~496x range already spanned with an exact-formula cross-check at every point.

preconditions.name: regression_fit_error_under_1pct_at_the_two_largest_most_representative_points
preconditions.detail: peak-RSS fit predicts within 0.8% and build-time fit within 0.6% of the actual K=256/KF=256 measurement, the point closest to the extrapolation target.

verdict: NO-GO at live scale, current dense (density=1.0) slot->filler wiring: host build alone needs ~316GB peak RSS / ~15.7min single-threaded (would OOM this 46GB-RAM dev machine and essentially any single consumer machine before a GPU array is ever created); the post-build GPU-resident steady state (~36-463GB depending on estimator) exceeds a single RTX 3090's 24GB by 1.5x-19x with zero allowance for the rest of the deployed brain. FHRR/RFPhasorComposer measured for real at the identical scale costs <1GB RAM and sub-second-per-query. Mitigation identified, not yet built: sparsify the slot->filler pathway (density << 1.0, a fixed small fan-out per slot instead of all-KF-pools) -- the roadmap's own L2 rung.
